[[Category:Line spectrum]]
[[File:Bohr-atom-animation.gif|thumbnail|An artistic impression of the excitation of an electron to a higher energy state by photon absorption and its return to its ground state by photon emission]]
In [[physics]], a '''line spectrum''' is either:

* An [[absorption spectrum]]
* An [[emission spectrum]]

In both cases, it is a proof that [[electron]]s can only occupy specific energy levels in an [[atom]]. In other words, electron energy is [[quantised]].
